category1.title: Profile category
category1.description: Which type of banking profile the customer is using or talking about.

values.name: business profile
values.description: Choose this if the comment contains ANY of these keywords or their obvious variants: Business, Cash flow, Profile, Two factor authentication (also 2FA / 2-factor), 2 way sign in, BTA, Business loan, Corporate, Y4B, BAS, Appointment booking, ABN, ACN, SMSF. If both business and personal cues are present, business profile wins.

values.name: personal profile
values.description: Choose this if there are NO business keywords (see business profile) but the comment has personal-banking cues such as: personal, home loan, savings, credit card, "my account", "my card", "my money", family terms (wife, husband, kids, mum, dad), etc.

values.name: general profile
values.description: Anything else: the comment has neither business keywords nor clear personal-banking cues (default).

category2.title: Comment / Issue reported
category2.description: The main topic of the comment.

values.name: transactions
values.description: Payments, transfers, PayID, BPAY, card payments, tap & pay, declined or pending transactions, account balances and transaction history.

values.name: onboarding and login
values.description: Opening an account, registration, identity verification, KYC, logging in, passwords, PINs, biometrics, two-factor / approval prompts, locked or blocked access.

values.name: feature enhancement
values.description: Requests for new features or improvements to existing features.

values.name: security
values.description: Fraud concerns, security threats, and everything else related to security.

values.name: closed account
values.description: The customer has closed, is closing or wants to close their account, or the bank closed or froze their account; complaints about account closure, leaving the bank, or being unable to close an account.

values.name: statements
values.description: Account statements, transaction history exports, tax or interest statements, and documents or reports.
